non_negotiable_steps.step: Run a vision-language model on the original image with the task text.
Derive a text-conditioned relevancy map from the visual encoder.
non_negotiable_steps.method: two variants: (a) Chefer-style attention x gradient relevancy w.r.t. the image-text similarity; (b) attention rollout (last-block CLS->patch mean-head) as a gradient-free fallback.

non_negotiable_steps.step: Localise a single ROI bounding box from the relevancy map (threshold + largest connected component + margin).
Crop and re-encode the ROI at the encoder's native resolution.

non_negotiable_steps.method: weighted average of softmaxed similarities; default weight 0.5.

deviations: VQA backend approximated by CLIP zero-shot MC scoring rather than an autoregressive LLaVA decoder due to local CPU/RAM.
